classes.criterion: Ground or return net: the reference that other nets' current returns through
Supply or load net carrying substantial current: input power, motor supplies, motor phase outputs, switched loads such as solenoids, pumps or heaters
Regulated low-voltage supply rail feeding logic and ICs, typically well under an amp
Connection between a crystal or resonator and its oscillator pins
Radio-frequency feed to an antenna, RF connector or RF module, needing controlled 50 ohm impedance
One half of a differential pair: USB data, Ethernet, LVDS, CAN, RS-485 or similar
Low-level analog signal whose accuracy suffers from noise: sensor outputs, ADC inputs, voltage references, audio, regulator feedback nodes
Ordinary digital or control signal at logic current: GPIO, enables, serial buses, resets, LED drive, transistor gate or base drive, switch inputs

tiers.criterion: Below 0.5 A: logic signals, LEDs, small regulated rails
0.5 to 2 A: a single motor phase, a small switched load, a moderate supply rail
2 to 5 A: a board's main input or a supply feeding several loads
Above 5 A: high-power supply, large motor or heater
